name: superlink-community
description: SuperLink Community — Smart Living. Safer Communities. One Connected Platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c teal,magenta "npm run dev -w @superlink/api" "npm run dev -w @superlink/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @superlink/shared && npm run build -w @superlink/api && npm run build -w @superlink/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @superlink/shared && npm run typecheck -w @superlink/api && npm run typecheck -w @superlink/web
